title: Find words faster
body: Word lists open faster and keep their colours when you change lengths: green for added, amber for already found or not yet confirmed, and red for not accepted.

title: Move through clues with N and P
body: With a word list open, press N or right-click outside a text field for the next unfinished clue; P goes back. Clues and Resources move together, skipping completed clues.

title: Put Resources on the left
body: Choose Options → Resources on the left to arrange your workspace. Your choice is remembered, and you can still swap Clues and Babble separately.

title: Keep your own progress journal
body: Options → Personal progress journal records your puzzles, word counts by length, longest words and active playing time. Recording starts off and stays on this device; export CSV or clear it any time.
